name: outseta
title: Outseta
description: Look up people and accounts, and triage support cases in your Outseta account.
author: antonio_manzanares

commands.name: search-people
commands.title: Search People
commands.subtitle: Outseta
commands.description: Search people in your Outseta CRM.

commands.name: search-accounts
commands.title: Search Accounts
commands.subtitle: Outseta
commands.description: Search accounts and see their plan and subscription status.

commands.name: support-cases
commands.title: Support Cases
commands.subtitle: Outseta
commands.description: Browse and reply to support cases.

preferences.name: subdomain
preferences.title: Subdomain
preferences.description: The part before .outseta.com in your admin URL. Use "demo" to try the extension with sample data.

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: API Key
preferences.description: Settings → Integrations → API Keys in Outseta.

preferences.name: secretKey
preferences.title: Secret Key
preferences.description: Shown once when the API key is created.

preferences.name: agentName
preferences.title: Agent Name
preferences.description: Your name as customers see it on support replies. Leave empty to sign replies with your company name.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
